name: ezrite-windows
description: Ezrite Windows판 (Electron 앱 + Rust 소리 받기 보조 프로그램)

scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml --config helper/.cargo/config.toml && npm --prefix app test
scripts.lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml --config helper/.cargo/config.toml -- -D warnings && npm --prefix app run lint
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm --prefix app run dist
